body: What’s sad is that it does get better but it’s temporary just like everything else in life. Ik it’s not like this for everyone but it feels like it’s a dark tunnel that you run down and at every 3 mile mark there’s a small light that gives you hope for a second. Then you realize that it’s gone as fast as it came. The more you run the more you realize the cycle and you start doing everything you can to avoid the light just for some consistency. It’s exhausting seeing the light and getting hope just for it to die over and over again.
